title: The Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress is vulnerable to Stored Cross-Site Scripting via the plugin's 'booking'…
description: The Booking Calendar plugin for WordPress contains a stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability in its 'booking' shortcode. This vulnerability affects all versions up to and including 12.0. It arises from insufficient input sanitization and output escaping on user-supplied attributes, allowing authenticated users with contributor-level access or higher to inject arbitrary scripts that execute when the affected pages are viewed.
